parameters.prompt: Minimalist hopeful deep space ambient, felt tempo around 65 BPM, designed as a perfectly seamless infinite loop. The beauty of exploring a vast solar system, discovering new planets and endless possibilities. Extremely sparse soundscape. Soft warm synthetic drone, gentle uplifting major-key suspended and add9 harmonies, subtle luminous atmospheric textures, occasional delicate sparkling crystal-like tones. Peaceful, optimistic, inspiring, comforting, and full of wonder. A sense of freedom, curiosity, discovery, and a bright future among the stars. Weightless and spacious, with very few sounds and plenty of breathing room. Only very slow subtle harmonic movement, absolutely no prominent melody, no rhythmic patterns, no pulse or beat, no arpeggios, no drums, no percussion, no heavy bass, no acoustic instruments, no vocals or choir. Avoid dark, melancholic, sad, lonely, ominous, mystical, temple-like, tense, or mysterious moods. Pure synthetic instrumental. Soft rounded attacks, airy but never harsh or piercing, restrained dynamics and gentle diffuse reverb. Consistent bright atmosphere throughout, no intro, no outro, no climax, no section changes, no transitions, no fade-in, no fade-out, no silence, no final cadence. Start already in the middle of the ongoing ambience. The end must return to the same harmony, timbre and energy as the beginning for continuous gapless looping. Original music without referencing or imitating named artists or existing soundtracks.
